records.context: Strategy:
records.label: spacr.qt.regex_detect.auto_detect_regex#1
records.source: Strategy:
records.translation: Aðferð:

records.context: 1. Try every :data:`BUILTIN_REGEXES` pattern; if one matches every file it wins immediately. 2. Otherwise pick the built-in that matches the MOST files (>=50 %). 3. Below 50 % coverage, try ``spacr.regex_infer.propose`` and return the first proposal with recognised metadata groups and more matches than the best built-in. 4. Otherwise try ``_synthesise_regex``. Keep the best built-in if synthesis fails, cannot compile, or matches fewer files. Equal match counts favour the synthesised pattern.
records.label: spacr.qt.regex_detect.auto_detect_regex#2
records.source: 1. Try every :data:`BUILTIN_REGEXES` pattern; if one matches every file it wins immediately. 2. Otherwise pick the built-in that matches the MOST files (>=50 %). 3. Below 50 % coverage, try ``spacr.regex_infer.propose`` and return the first proposal with recognised metadata groups and more matches than the best built-in. 4. Otherwise try ``_synthesise_regex``. Keep the best built-in if synthesis fails, cannot compile, or matches fewer files. Equal match counts favour the synthesised pattern.
records.translation: 1. Prófa hvert mynstur í :data:`BUILTIN_REGEXES`; ef eitt passar við allar skrár er það valið strax. 2. Annars er innbyggða mynstrið sem passar við FLESTAR skrár valið (>=50 %). 3. Við þekju undir 50 % er ``spacr.regex_infer.propose`` prófað og fyrsta tillagan með þekktum lýsigagnahópum og fleiri samsvörunum en besta innbyggða mynstrið skilað. 4. Annars er ``_synthesise_regex`` prófað. Besta innbyggða mynstrinu er haldið ef myndun mistekst, ekki er hægt að þýða mynstrið eða það passar við færri skrár. Ef fjöldi samsvarana er jafn er myndaða mynstrið valið.

records.source: Hosts variously hold ``src`` (a run folder), ``src/measurements`` or the database itself, so all three resolve here rather than in each caller.
records.translation: Hýsiskjáir forritsins geta geymt ``src`` (keyrslumöppu), ``src/measurements`` eða gagnagrunninn sjálfan, svo allar þrjár gerðir eru leystar hér í stað þess að hvert kallandi fall geri það.

records.translation: skrá, keyrslumappa eða mælingamappa.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.column_picker.resolve_db_path#3
records.source: absolute, user-expanded candidate path. For an existing directory, search for an existing file at its ``measurements/measurements.db`` then ``measurements.db``; if neither exists, return the former candidate. Other inputs are returned without checking existence or a ``.db`` extension.
records.translation: algild möguleg slóð þar sem heimasvæði notandans hefur verið leyst upp. Fyrir möppu sem er til er fyrst leitað að skrá undir ``measurements/measurements.db`` og síðan ``measurements.db`` innan hennar; ef hvorug er til er fyrri mögulegu slóðinni skilað. Öðrum inntökum er skilað án þess að athuga hvort þau séu til eða hafi endinguna ``.db``.

records.context: Chart ``spec``'s control value plate by plate over run order.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart.control_chart#0
records.source: Chart ``spec``'s control value plate by plate over run order.
records.translation: Teikna viðmiðunargildi ``spec`` fyrir hverja plötu í keyrsluröð.

records.context: The whole policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that one point is drawn per laboratory microplate in processing-session order, sigma comes from the selected estimator, the limits are estimated from a stated baseline and applied forward, and every rule that fires is reported by number, in words, and with the laboratory microplates it fired on. Automatic estimator selection uses within-laboratory microplate subgroup variation when a laboratory microplate has multiple control microplate sample positions, and moving ranges otherwise.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart.control_chart#1
records.source: The whole policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that one point is drawn per plate in run order, sigma comes from the selected estimator, the limits are estimated from a stated baseline and applied forward, and every rule that fires is reported by number, in words, and with the plates it fired on. Automatic estimator selection uses within-plate subgroup variation when a plate has multiple control wells, and moving ranges otherwise.
records.translation: Öll stefnan er í skjölunarstreng einingarinnar; í stuttu máli er einn punktur teiknaður fyrir hverja plötu í keyrsluröð, sigma kemur frá völdu mati, mörkin eru metin út frá tilgreindu grunnviðmiði og notuð áfram, og hver regla sem virkjast er tilgreind með númeri, í orðum og með þeim plötum sem hún virkjaðist á. Sjálfvirkt val matsaðferðar notar breytileika undirhóps innan plötu þegar plata hefur fleiri en einn viðmiðunarbrunn, en annars hlaupandi spönn.

records.source: ``(column index, first row, last row)`` spans that changed, already clipped to the canvas. A column contributes nothing when its rounded strip position in pixels is unchanged and it has not respawned; movement within an integer row can still produce a changed span.
records.translation: ``(column index, first row, last row)``-bil sem breyttust, þegar afmörkuð við teikniflötinn. Dálkur leggur ekkert til þegar afrúnnuð staðsetning ræmunnar í pixlum er óbreytt og hann hefur ekki birst aftur; hreyfing innan heiltöluraðar getur samt valdið breyttu bili.

records.source: point opacity, clipped to 0.05-1.0, for unlabeled points and nonnegative cluster labels. Noise points and the fallback for mismatched label shape retain their palette opacity.
records.translation: þekja punkta, takmörkuð við 0.05-1.0, fyrir ómerkta punkta og klasamerki sem eru ekki neikvæð. Suðpunktar og varaleiðin þegar lögun merkja passar ekki halda þekju litavalsins.

records.context: one :class:`FieldQC` per microscope field of view, in source iteration order. Directory filenames are sorted; mappings and sequences retain their input order. An empty list when the source holds no mask — that is not an error, it is what a run with ``save=False`` looks like.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc.score_masks#4
records.source: one :class:`FieldQC` per field, in source iteration order. Directory filenames are sorted; mappings and sequences retain their input order. An empty list when the source holds no mask — that is not an error, it is what a run with ``save=False`` looks like.
records.translation: einn :class:`FieldQC` fyrir hvert myndsvið, í ítrunarröð gagnagjafans. Skráarnöfnum í möppum er raðað; varpanir og runur halda upprunalegri inntaksröð sinni. Tómur listi ef gagnagjafinn inniheldur enga grímu — það er ekki villa, heldur niðurstaða keyrslu með ``save=False``.
